_epistemic.status: SUPERSEDED REFERENCE — CE-era in-memory convention, not how flags are resolved today.
_epistemic.what: The Cheat-Engine-era Rosetta table: flag_id -> (byte_offset, bit_position) as an IN-MEMORY offset, plus a name/category guess and optional world coordinates. Extracted verbatim from the retired src/db/event_flags.rs (BACKLOG step 5).
_epistemic.trust: LOW / UNVERIFIED. byte_offset/bit_position are in-memory coordinates from third-party CE tables, NOT save-file byte positions. Names and categories are best-effort labels of unverified provenance. coords are in-game world positions from the same era.
_epistemic.do_not: Do not use these offsets to read a save. Live flag positions float per save and are resolved by crates/wasm-event-flags (ADR-0005); verified claims live in knowledge/claims/event-flags.json (ADR-0004). See knowledge/reference/README.md.
_epistemic.source: src/db/event_flags.rs @ commit before step-5 deletion (EVENT_FLAGS_INFO static)
